description: This Java class implements a manager for storing and retrieving product image files using Infinispan cache, supporting operations like add, get, and remove images, specifically for product images in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Manager class for handling product image storage and retrieval using Infinispan cache, supporting multiple operations such as add, get, remove images, and cache management.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, typically called during servlet undeploy.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern method to get the instance of the manager.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache for a specific product.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image from cache based on product image details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images for a given product or merchant store.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image from cache.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image with optional size parameter.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Fetches or creates a cache node for a given path.
